notes: PRIMARY of a duplicate pair: also exists as I182541959347, a bare orphan stub (no parents, no spouses — missing both Mary Lyons and Anna Dugard/Dugan entirely, zero sources) retained only as the parent link for duplicate son I182541959308.

This record's two marriages are externally corroborated: A.G. Hibbard, 'Genealogy of the Hibbard Family Who Are Descendants of Robert Hibbard of Salem, Massachusetts' (Hartford: Case, 1901), entry 163: 'Joseph6 (s. Joseph4, Jeremiah3, Joseph2, Robert1), b. Manchester, Mass., April 23, 1751; m. (1) 1775, Mary Lyons, (2) July 9, 1780, Mrs. Anna Dugan of Marblehead (b. 1760; d. Dec. 19, 1804)' — matches this record's spouses, dates and place exactly ('Anna Dugard' in the tree vs. 'Anna Dugan' in the book, an ordinary period spelling variant). See docs/research/ancestors/gen08-joseph-hibbard-iii-hannah-pond.md.
